role: The region cache: the region store's seed-world build (serverreplay.c sr_ensure_saved) runs once per distinct input and every later replay maps its image from ~/.cache/netherite-regioncache. The key is a SHA-1 of the build hash (the Makefile's hash of csrc/engine, compiler and flags), the struct sizes, the seed, the quiet-join pin, the run_config and the big-tree state; the image is the seed world's chunks (struct, packed sections, tile entities, pending ticks), the creatures after their pass, and the env state the build leaves (big-tree state, entity chunk stamp advance, the item tags it used in first-use order).
gpu: function regioncache_begin/regioncache_capture: file I/O (open, mmap, flock, rename, readdir) inside the first chunk load of a tick, once per replay; host only, like the build it replaces
function regioncache_chunk: chunk_new, malloc of the packed blob and calloc of each tile entity in the tick (the build it replaces allocated 170,000 times)
function rc_mode: getenv("HOME") for the default cache directory
notes: Ports no oracle/src file. A miss builds, captures and applies the image exactly as a hit does. --region-cache verify rebuilds and exits 3 when the stored image differs (lane/regioncache: every seed-world recording verified against the three keys the suite has).
